links.name: Grafana
links.note: Not exposed: start the port-forward on a machine with cluster access, then open the link. User admin; the second command prints the password (it comes from the sealed secret grafana-admin).
commands: kubectl -n monitoring get secret grafana-admin -o jsonpath='{.data.admin-password}' | base64 -d; echo

links.name: Prometheus
links.note: Targets, rules and queries. No sign-in; reachable only through the port-forward.

links.name: Alertmanager
links.note: Alerts and silences. No sign-in; reachable only through the port-forward.

links.name: Argo CD
links.note: User admin with the password chosen at the bootstrap (the initial secret is deleted; keep it in your password manager). The certificate is self-signed.

links.name: Actions
links.note: CI, releases, the weekly scans and the kind rehearsal. Sign in to GitHub with an account that can read the repository.

links.name: Pull requests
links.note: A merged gitops-bump pull request deploys a release; reverting it rolls back (docs/RUNBOOK.md).

links.name: Container images
links.note: finuance-api and finuance-web on ghcr.io, signed with cosign (docs/RUNBOOK.md).
